articles.title: Rivers in the Sky Are Soaking the Pacific Northwest
articles.summary: Atmospheric rivers — narrow bands of water vapor in the sky — are bringing days of heavy rain to Oregon and Washington, with flooding risks where they meet high tides.

articles.title: Microsoft's Big Outage Leaves Millions Unable to Email
articles.summary: A major Microsoft outage stopped millions from using Outlook, Teams and Copilot; Microsoft rules out a cyber-attack and says fixes are under way.

articles.title: Every Fraction of a Degree Counts for the Planet
articles.summary: A tiny rise in temperature can mean huge changes for corals, heat waves, and storms — and countries meeting in Turkey are talking about how to slow it down.
